aggregation: Per-epoch/per-variable valid coarse samples inside the full audited Ontario polygon, retaining zero; no mask intersection across future epochs. Publish coverage and missingness. No outcome-conditioned location weighting.
time_policy: Latest epoch strictly before annual example; no interpolation from later epochs. This is retrospective reconstructed inventory: full-series future imagery prevents an as-of forecasting claim even with a prior-epoch join.
recovery_policy: No same-event eventual recovery-rate map predictor. Compare explicitly labelled prior-epoch biomass-change and prior-year recorded fire-area memory proxies; neither is measured spectral recovery or FBP fuel hazard.
nodata_policy: Read signed/unsigned datatype and numeric nodata per resource. Never apply height uint8/255 assumptions to biomass or stand age. Check per-frame resampling eligibility and absence of band scale/offset transformations before aggregation.
scope: Bounded source audit/acquisition only, no fitting, hardware or final-year access.
resampling_policy: Revision before pixel acquisition or model fitting: age2005/2010/2015 source coarse frames omit resampling metadata. Retain numerical summaries as descriptive only; model_eligible=false. Predictive inputs use latest prior eligible age epoch, explicitly reporting staleness. Other layers and earlier age epochs advertise NEAREST. No inference that missing metadata means NEAREST.
